name: Benjamin Mühlemann
bio: Benjamin Mühlemann (born 1 February 1979 in Mollis, canton of Glarus) is a Swiss politician of the FDP.Die Liberalen. He has represented the canton of Glarus in the Council of States (Ständerat) since the federal elections of October 2023, succeeding party colleague Thomas Hefti. Before entering federal politics he served in the cantonal government of Glarus (Regierungsrat) from 2014 to May 2024, heading first the Department of Education and Culture and from 2021 the Department of Finance and Health, and was Landammann (cantonal president) from 2022. In October 2025 he was elected co-president of the FDP.Die Liberalen of Switzerland alongside Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher.
